scope: Result publication and pending-slot finalization; no model or project mutation

assertions: First Etas process persisted a complete result while retaining pending
New Etas process settled the pending slot through production tool_finished
Original result remained unchanged and no duplicate event was added
Full product compiled and reopened the earlier native SQLite schema
Existing applied journal, conversation and ledger were retained
No-pending reconciliation returned without any project dispatch

limitations: This does not establish every interruption window or full lifecycle acceptance
Unfinished file journals still require explicit rollback
Unversioned complete requests without a journal retain unknown outcome
Native command approval provenance still depends on etas-interpreter#102
